about: The conformance matrix: for each program, the result the specification says it has, compared with the implementation on the unoptimized pipeline and after std::opt. A reading is what the named principle says the program prints and returns; it is never copied from what the implementation happened to print. See README.md for the columns and their coverage.

cases.name: same_resource_order
cases.principle: 3.3, the effects that run on one resource run in written order
cases.what: Two println calls on stdout are written one after the other; the first prints 9 before the second prints 0, and main returns the first.

cases.name: same_resource_order_call
cases.principle: 3.3, a call is one effect on the resources its callee reaches
cases.what: A call whose callee prints keeps its place between the println calls written beside it.

cases.name: dce_effect_under_pure_arithmetic
cases.principle: 3.4, the effects of the statements a sync block writes happen
cases.what: The statement of a sync block prints 5 whether or not anything reads its value; dropping the unread subtraction may not drop the print.

cases.name: inline_argument_effect
cases.principle: 3.4, an argument is used where the call is written
cases.what: The argument println(9) runs although the callee never reads that parameter; inlining may not drop it with the unused port.

cases.name: fold_keeps_arm_effect
cases.principle: 3.1 and 9.7, what the program uses runs, and a rewrite keeps it
cases.what: The effect the dropped arm read from outside keeps running after the branch is folded.

cases.name: branch_keeps_outer_effect
cases.principle: 3.1 and 9.7, the same, with the branch's value read by an arithmetic whose other operand is an effect
cases.what: Both calls print 1 before the 3 written after the branch, through the fold as well as without it.

cases.name: unused_effect_not_executed
cases.principle: 3.1, an effect nothing uses does not run
cases.what: An effect whose result nothing uses is not executed, before or after optimization; a pass that runs it adds output the program does not have.
